evidence.title: Lumen - Modern landing page template Next.js & Astro - Shadcnblocks.com

name: Lumen
summary: Landing page and marketing site template for Next.js and Astro with 22 pages and 100+ shadcn/ui sections.
description: A landing page and marketing website template built with shadcn/ui and Tailwind 4, sold as a one-time purchase. It ships 22 pages and 100+ block sections in Next.js and Astro editions, with MDX content, data JSON, a Figma file and SEO metadata.
contains: tested one-shot deploys on Vercel, Netlify and Cloudflare Pages
